Description:
AT Aviation is delighted to present this well-maintained 2002 Cirrus SR20 G1, N100YY. Although an early-generation example, this aircraft has clearly benefited from conscientious ownership and significant investment throughout its life. The Cirrus SR20 has earned its reputation as one of the finest modern touring aircraft, combining impressive performance, advanced safety features and exceptional handling. For pilots looking to move on from traditional trainers such as the Piper PA-28 or Cessna 172, the SR20 represents the perfect introduction to high-performance composite aircraft. Offering excellent cruise speeds, a spacious cabin and the reassurance of the Cirrus Airframe Parachute System (CAPS), it is an ideal platform for both personal travel and hour building.

‍

Inside the cockpit, N100YY offers an impressive avionics suite, featuring an Aspen Evolution PFD, dual Garmin GNS430 WAAS GPS, an Avidyne EX5000C Entegra MFD and the renowned S-TEC 55X autopilot. Combined with its IFR certification, this provides excellent capability for both touring and instrument flying, while the aircraft's efficient cruise of around 155 knots burning 10-11gph makes travelling across the UK and Europe both practical and economical. (Owner-reported)

‍

The aircraft has always been hangared and meticulously maintained, with regular 25-hour oil and filter changes between annual inspections. Cosmetic condition is equally impressive, with a smart grey leather interior complemented by a well-presented exterior. The Cirrus Airframe Parachute System (CAPS) was repacked by ASG in Guernsey in October 2022, with the next scheduled repack not due until 2032. The line cutters were renewed by RGV in 2024 and are not due for replacement again until 2031. Offering the next owner many years before these key components require attention.

‍

Offered for sale at £150,000.00, N100YY represents outstanding value for anyone looking to step into Cirrus ownership. Whether you're upgrading, seeking a capable touring aircraft or wanting an economical, low-time example with many of the major maintenance costs already behind it, this SR20 is ready to fly and enjoy from day one.

‍

An excellent opportunity to own one of general aviation's most popular and confidence-inspiring aircraft.

These early SR20’s are much lighter than the later models giving excellent useful load, higher cruise speeds and delightful handling. This particular model has had the vacuum system removed from the old gauges making it even lighter. UK and EU VAT PAID.

Free 3 day Embark transition training available with a CSIP. IR(R) & CB-IR available through our ATO to take full advantage of this incredible aircraft.

Description:
The Rockwell 114 is regarded as the Mercedes-Benz of the General Aviation fleet. It looks like what it is, a roomy well engineered touring aircraft. This particular aircraft was the pride and joy of a keen Pilot, who bought it from Commander Aircraft Company in 1990 and ferried it across the Atlantic. In 1995 he won the Kings Cup Air Race with it at Leicester, and the aircraft has been up to the Artic Circle in his care. The aircraft was used to fly up and down to France from his farm strip, and it is known to be a particularly fast example.

In November 2025 we bought this aeroplane, brought it to Aerofab for an annual and had them upgrade the audio panel. The airframe is from 1977 YOM and has just 2568hrs TTAF. The engine is a Lycoming Factory roller tappet engine from May 2008 with 295hrs SMOH. The Two Blade Hartzell Constant Speed prop was overhauled in June 2018 with 82hrs ran. At the last annual we had fitted a new Concorde Battery, 12x new Tempest Plugs and a new mechanical fuel pump. The annual runs to 21st April 2027 and the aircraft is operated on an ODMP.

The avionics have been upgraded with a Trig TMA44 Audio Panel, Trig TY96 Com and Trig TT31 Mode S transponder. The panel has a King KNS80 RNAV/ILS/DME, King KR-87 ADF and King KX-175 Nav/Com and a RAM ball mount for iPad/GPS. The paint and interior are original from 1977 and the aircraft benefits from factory corrosion proofing. The interior is comfortable with dual opening front windows and four place intercom, just dated cosmetically.

There are plenty of modified, newer, heavier 114’s on the market and maybe that is what you are shopping for. G-LADS is that fast, light, original aircraft with low total time and a great engine that highlights what the 114 excels at. The aircraft shows 1075lbs of useful load and the previous owners notes show the aircraft did 144kts at FL105 at 18”/2300rpm burning 11.5 gph which is remarkably efficient for a big retractable that can operate off a farm strip. Down low at 3000ft and 23/2300 the aircraft still shows 140kts at 12.5 USG. There’s a lot of capability here in the right hands. In America they are very sought after for their twin aircraft cabin size, two door access and luxurious cross country capability, in Europe they fetch less money so at $79,950 we think this aircraft is excellent value for someone looking to step up to a 114. You could buy a 200hp Commander 112 at this price point, but the difference with the extra 60hp is night and day. The fuel injected 260hp Lycoming IO-540 is the engine this big aircraft deserves.

The aircraft is being sold due to an order for a new G750 of the same make. It was primarily used for cruising on the Switzerland-Croatia route. Alcantara seats with inflatable backrests are included. Transponder, ELT, ADS in/out, and FLARM are also installed. A backup alternator and a backup battery complete the package. The fuel tank capacity is 140 liters, and fuel consumption varies between 17 and 22 liters per hour depending on the power output. Swiss VAT of 8.1% included.

World-class beaches, surf breaks, outstanding fishing, and an abundance of stunning native flora and fauna are all right on your doorstep.

Complete with a full concrete floor, extensive lighting, numerous power outlets, and a security camera system, it provides infrastructure rarely found in lifestyle properties.

 

A second 12m x 9m* shed with concrete flooring and power offers additional storage and workshop space.

HISTORY & BACKGROUND
Built in 1947 and originally delivered to the Iraqi Air Force, it was operated with the code 308. After retirement from service and several years in storage it was one of around two dozen Fury/ Sea Fury airframes acquired in 1979 by David Tallichet and Ed Jurist. Registered N26SF, it was initially put into storage in Orlando, Florida, until being sold to Guido Zuccoli in 1982, and named “Baghdad Fury”. It has been registered as VH-HFG in 1983 and made its first post restoration flight on November 14th.
The aircraft remained owned by the Zuccoli family and has been acquired by Stefano Landi in 2019 and flown as D-CRZY.
In November 2023 it was moved to France and registered as F-AYSF.

If you are looking for an aerobatic trainer to replace, or add to your current fleet, look no further - We manufacture the perfect solution in a robust, fast, fully aerobatic airframe that OUTPERFORMS ALL OTHERS!

The CT-4 is a widely loved Aircraft that has trained many of the top military pilots over the past decades.  Through the incorporation of modern avionics this aircraft has transformed into a proven agile and robust fully aerobatic (+6G to -3G) aircraft which remains at the forefront of ab initio military trainer aircraft.

The CT-4 is a two side-by-side seater, single engine, low wing, all metal monoplane with fixed tricycle undercarriage that is able to operate in VFR and IFR conditions.

With its well proven and powerful 300hp Lycoming engine and three bladed propeller, provides a very capable aircraft which challenges the students while also being a forgiving platform. Description:
Perhaps the only Mooney 252 Encore with FIKI for sale anywhere in the World, N97NM is ready to go a new home. Mooney enthusiasts will know how few 252's come for sale, and of those how few are Encore specification with 220hp and 3130lbs MTOW. Of those tiny few Encores, remember Mooney only made 27 of them how few of the remaining aircraft have FIKI TKS. This is a very select aircraft for someone searching for a specific model.

The Mooney 252 TSE moves like a knife in the flight levels, and runs wingtip to wingtip with C90 King Airs. It is perhaps the ultimate personal four-seater, and while we have it for sale we intend to enjoy it.

N97NM is further distinguished as a full Encore-specification aircraft, upgraded from the standard 210hp 252 to the 220hp Encore configuration by Eagle Aircraft in February 2007 — widely regarded among Mooney enthusiasts as the sweet spot in the M20K line. We will supply you a copy of the Backwards Tales, and you can read all about why Mooney people rave about the 252.

This aircraft also carries a genuine transatlantic pedigree, having been flown across the North Atlantic via Canada, Greenland and Iceland to Europe — a well-documented trip, with full day-by-day route records available to any interested buyer. The aircraft is currently flying, fresh out of annual and it would be a pleasure to fly with you.

AIRCRAFT HISTORY
In the early 1950’s the US Air Force contracted with the Canada Car & Foundry for 285 aircraft to be built to T-6G specifications and then designated them as T-6J
models for the Mutual Defense Assistance Program (MDAP).
CCF-4-452 was manufactured by the Canada Car & Foundry in 1953. US Air Force personnel tested and accepted -542 and designated it with USAF serial number
53-4623. It was then exported to the German Air Force as part of the MDAP.
-542 served as a trainer with the designation AA-682 for the newly reformed German Luftwaffe when it joined NATO in 1955. It served with the Luftwaffe until it
was exported to the Portuguese Air Force and designated as -1781.
Now serving in the Portuguese air force -542 was sent to Portugal's then Province of Mozambique. From 1964-1969 -542 and the other Portuguese Air Force T-6’s
saw combat as a ground attack air-craft in what was called the Mondlane Insurgency. At the close of the conflict, It was abandoned by the defeated Portuguese and
designated as written off.
The victorious new regime put -542 on static display as a war trophy in the town square of the capitol city of Maputo. It was displayed there until 1989. It was then
that Tony Watson of South Africa purchased a lot of 12 ex-Mozambique Air Force T-6’s and Harvard's Including –542 and ex-ported them from Mozambique to
South Africa.
-542 changed hands several times within South Africa and was finally purchased by a collector who exported it for restoration. He has the sister ship to -542
restored and flying in original German colors and markings in Johannesburg.
AIRCRAFT HISTORY CONTINUED
The restoration of -542 began when it was exported from South Africa to AvSpecs in New Zealand who began some initial tear down of the project. It was then
sent to Historic Aircraft Restorations and renowned warbird restorer Ron Greinert in Australia. A restoration plan was created that called For complete
disassembly treating all components as “Unserviceable” and replacing all life limited parts with new or overhauled components.
The aircraft was placed in jigs where airframe components were refurbished to new standards. Power Plant and Prop were sourced with “0” time since overhaul
and Installed. all new wiring harnesses and hoses and cabling were installed. Period cockpits were created using overhauled and refaced original instruments with
the addition of only necessary modern warning lights and avionics.
It was decided by its owner that it should be returned to its original German Air Force livery upon completion. Authentic placarding and stenciling is found
throughout the aircraft.
In 2018 The aircraft was ground run in Australia and then disassembled for shipping to PJ Aviation in the United States for reassembly, certification and final
restoration. Work on the aircraft was completed in St. Paul, Minnesota by Two Brothers Aviation.
The aircraft has only test time flight time and ferry since reassembly and is certified and registered in the United States.
-542 is a rare combat veteran aircraft that has never been on the civilian registry prior to its restoration. It likely is the nicest flying version of the T-6/Harvard in
the world and shows as new as the day It rolled off the Foundry's assembly line.

Description:
THE WORLD’S ONLY ORIGINAL FACTORY-BUILT TWO-SEAT MESSERSCHMITT Bf 109
One of Two Built • Sole Survivor • Full Dual Controls • Rolls-Royce Merlin Powered
An extraordinary opportunity to acquire what is believed to be the world’s only surviving original factory-built, two-seat Messerschmitt Bf 109.
This historically significant aircraft is one of only two two-seat Bf 109s constructed under license by Hispano Aviación, and is the only surviving example.
Unlike modern two-seat conversions, this aircraft was originally manufactured in a two-seat configuration and is equipped with a complete set of dual flight controls.
This factory two-seat configuration provides an exceptionally rare capability in the Bf 109 family. A qualified pilot can occupy either cockpit, allowing the aircraft to be used for dual-control pilot familiarization, differences or transition training where permitted, demonstration flying, and passenger flight experiences when authorized under the aircraft’s applicable certification and operating limitations.
For an owner already operating historic aircraft, the second set of controls also provides a significant advantage for pilot checkout and familiarization, allowing an experienced Bf 109 pilot or instructor to accompany a pilot becoming accustomed to the aircraft rather than requiring the pilot’s first experience to be alone in a single-seat fighter.
Power is provided by the legendary Rolls-Royce Merlin, producing approximately 1,700 horsepower. Combined with an aircraft weighing approximately 4,500 pounds, the result is an extraordinary power-to-weight ratio and truly exhilarating performance.
Few warbirds combine this level of rarity with such practical dual-control capability. The aircraft offers something virtually unobtainable elsewhere: the opportunity for two occupants to experience a genuine, purpose-built two-seat derivative of the Bf 109 with full flight controls available from both cockpits.
For the serious warbird collector, museum, historic aircraft operator, or flight-experience organization, this aircraft represents a uniquely significant and potentially highly usable example of one of history’s most recognizable fighter designs.

Description:
The latest arrival to the AT Aviation showroom is G-UAVA a striking 1967 Piper PA-30 Twin Comanche (Turbo B) that combines timeless ramp appeal with the renowned efficiency and performance that have made the Twin Comanche one of the most respected light twins ever produced. Presented in a lovely white and metallic blue paint scheme and showing just 3,280 airframe hours from new, this is an honest, well-cared-for example that offers an excellent opportunity for both touring and IFR-capable operations. With valid ARC and Annual through 2027, G-UAVA is ready to be enjoyed immediately.

‍

‍

The PA-30 B model introduced a number of refinements over the original aircraft, including the addition of a third side window and improved cabin appointments, helping cement the Twin Comanche's reputation as one of the most practical and comfortable aircraft in its class. This particular example offers seating for six and benefits from a recently refurbished interior finished in attractive grey leather with bespoke Comanche detailing embroidered into the seats. The cabin presents beautifully and provides a modern, comfortable environment for both pilots and passengers alike.

‍

‍

Under the cowlings sit a pair of Lycoming IO-320-C1A engines, each with approximately 1,560 hours since overhaul. This aircraft also benefits from the desirable LoPresti cowl conversion, enhancing both aesthetics and aerodynamic efficiency while improving engine cooling characteristics. Fuel capacity is significantly increased through the addition of the 30USG auxiliary tanks and 30USG tip tanks, making G-UAVA an exceptionally capable touring aircraft with impressive endurance and range, allowing owners to make the most of the Twin Comanche's renowned fuel efficiency.

‍

‍

The avionics suite is comprehensive and well suited to modern touring and IFR operations, featuring a Garmin GNS 530 GPS/NAV/COM, Garmin GTX 330 Transponder, Garmin GMA 340 audio panel, along with ADF, DME and the addition of the Stormscope WX1000E and an S-TEC 60 autopilot. Combining low airframe hours, an attractive specification and a smart modern interior, G-UAVA represents an excellent example of Piper's legendary Twin Comanche and is now available for viewing at the AT Aviation showroom.

Description:
F-HVEC is a well-maintained 2000 Piper PA-46-350P Mirage with 3,031 total hours and a fresh January 2026 annual inspection. Operated by an aeronautic club (acquired from German first-hand owner at ~ 600h TTAF) and maintained under the owner’s CAO, the aircraft benefits from complete logbook history and consistent care throughout its life.

In 2009, after a loss of directional control on landing by the pilot in strong crosswind conditions, the aircraft departed the runway into rough grass. The nose undercarriage collapsed leading to a prop strike. The firewall has been repaired, propeller and engine were subsequently replaced and installed new in 2009.

The Lycoming TIO-540-AE2A engine has since accumulated approximately 1,910 hours since. In October 2021, all six cylinders were replaced and have since accrued only around 320 hours, with the engine reported by the maintenance facility to be in very good condition. Equipped for comfortable IFR flying, the aircraft also features speed brakes and an attractive Garmin avionics suite.

Finished in a striking white, blue and gold scheme, F-HVEC presents in very good overall condition.

This well-equipped Mirage combines modern Garmin avionics, pressurized comfort, and proven cross-country capability, making it an excellent choice for both business and personal travel.

Description:
Rare opportunity to acquire a fully operational and airworthy PA-31-310 with genuinely low-time engines and propellers, complete records, full de-ice capability, dual Garmin GNS 530W WAAS/LPV avionics and a very good 8-seat interior. 

A well-equipped Navajo that is ready for its next owner.

LOW-TIME ENGINES — 653 / 720 H SMOH
CURRENT ANNUAL & ARC — AIRWORTHY & OPERATIONAL
FULLY DE-ICED — WAAS/LPV — 8 SEATS

OY-DLY is a particularly attractive example of the classic Piper PA-31-310 Turbo Navajo, offering a combination that is increasingly difficult to find on the European market:

LOW-TIME ENGINES • LOW-TIME PROPELLERS • FULL DE-ICE • WAAS/LPV • 8 SEATS • AIRWORTHY CONDITION

The aircraft has 10,050 hours total airframe time, but the two Lycoming TIO-540-A2B engines have only 653 and 720 hours since major overhaul respectively.

The Hartzell 3-blade propellers have only 298 and 418 hours since overhaul.

For a PA-31 buyer, these are important numbers.

WHY OY-DLY?

The market contains older Navajos at lower asking prices, but the purchase price alone does not tell the whole story.

A buyer should consider the condition, engine times, propeller times, airworthiness status, equipment and immediate maintenance requirements of each aircraft.

OY-DLY is currently airworthy and operational, with its systems functional and the aircraft available for inspection in airworthy and operational condition.

For a PA-31 buyer, the relevant comparison is not simply the advertised purchase price, but also engine and propeller times, current airworthiness status, equipment and immediate maintenance requirements.

THE RIGHT NAVAJO FOR A BUYER WHO WANTS TO FLY

OY-DLY is not being presented as the cheapest Navajo on the market.

It is being offered as a well-equipped, operational and airworthy Navajo with low-time engines and propellers, full de-ice capability, modern WAAS/LPV avionics and a very good interior.

For a buyer looking for a PA-31 for serious IFR travelling, family or business transportation, the combination of engine time, equipment, cabin condition and present airworthiness deserves close consideration.

Pre-purchase inspection is welcome.

Serious buyers are invited to inspect the aircraft and review the complete maintenance records.

Both engines have low time since overhaul (653/720 SMOH) and are currently operated on-condition. The calendar overhaul interval has elapsed; continued operation is in accordance with the applicable approved maintenance programme.

With just 3,481 airframe hours, this low-time DR400 has been exceptionally well cared for and is ready for its next adventure. Its Annual and ARC are valid until February 2027,  allowing the new owner to get straight into enjoying everything this fantastic aircraft has to offer.

The Lycoming engine has accumulated 1,576 hours since overhaul in 1994 and underwent a shock-load inspection in 2015.

‍

The Robin DR400 has earned a great reputation as a touring aircraft, G-SELL demonstrates impressive performance with the 180 HP engine and operates well off grass strips. Its responsive centre-stick controls provide wonderfully balanced handling, making every flight engaging and enjoyable, while the spacious cabin and iconic wraparound canopy deliver exceptional visibility that few aircraft can rival. If you can picture yourself exploring the coastline, crossing the Channel, or enjoying a relaxed evening flight, the panoramic views from G-SELL create an unforgettable flying experience for both pilot and passengers alike!

‍

At AT Aviation, the Robin DR400 remains one of our absolute favourite aircraft, and it's easy to understand why. They are practical, economical, immensely capable tourers that never fail to put a smile on your face every time you take to the skies. We can't wait to welcome you to our showroom and show you everything this beautiful Robin has to offer.

Description:
The Robinson R66 Turbine is a five seat helicopter that incorporates many of the design features of its reputable predecessor, the Robinson R44, including a two-bladed rotor system, T-bar cyclic and an open interior cabin configuration, but with significant improvements in performance, comfort, and safety through the factory fitted engine monitoring system.

At last, a 5 seat turbine helicopter that does everything you want and more. The innovative lightweight engineering combined with a fuel efficient powerful engine mean that you are going places, fast and leaving nothing behind. A wide range of mission customization options offers a huge range of solutions with lower emissions than equivalent types.

Robinson R66 Operating Performance
The new RR300 turbine engine gives the Robinson R66 helicopter its edge. This fast helicopter combines huge amounts of power high speeds and luxurious comfort. With 5 seats, a large luggage bay capacity and excellent proven reliability, the Robinson R66 is the perfect private and commercial helicopter combination. The Robinson R66 combines a high cruise speed of 120 kts with a very low fuel consumption, meaning extra low fuel costs and low fuel emissions. Low maintenance and running costs complete perfect R66 helicopter solution.

Robinson R66 Versatility
The R66 Turbine is equipped with an RR300, large baggage compartment, and a long range with four passengers and bags. It can be equipped to deal with aerial filming, aerial surveillance, passenger & freight transport, police operations, load lifting and more. With low cost simple maintenance plans, it ticks all the boxes.

And why not add the HeliSAS and Autopilot too.

Description:
AT Aviation are pleased to present G-OARC, a Piper Arrow IV. RC offers a natural step up from both the Warrior and the Archer, the Arrow introduces retractable landing gear and a constant-speed propeller, making it the ideal aircraft for pilots looking to build experience on complex aircraft while retaining the renowned handling characteristics and reliability that Piper is famous for. Whether you're looking for an aircraft for hour building, a new addition to your flight training fleet or comfortable tourer, this Arrow IV is a superb all-rounder.

G-OARC has accumulated 7,275 airframe hours and the Lycoming engine has 1,550 hours since overhaul, completed in 2018. The engine remains well within both calendar and hourly limits, leaving plenty of life remaining, making this an excellent proposition for both private owners and flying schools alike. The aircraft will be supplied with a fresh Annual Inspection, allowing its new owner to fly away with confidence.

One of the standout features of G-OARC is its exceptional avionics fit. The panel is centred around a modern Garmin suite featuring dual Garmin G5 electronic flight instruments, a Garmin GTN 650 GPS/NAV/COM, Garmin Audio panel and Garmin Transponder, providing outstanding situational awareness and capability. Completing the package is the highly desirable Garmin GFC 500 digital autopilot, making cross-country touring a pleasure while significantly reducing pilot workload. Traditional DME and ADF equipment are also installed, providing excellent flexibility for IFR training too.

As a normally aspirated Arrow IV, it benefits from slightly lower operating costs and simpler maintenance compared to its turbocharged counterpart, while still delivering great cruise performance and load-carrying capability. The Arrow's forgiving flight characteristics, robust construction and widespread parts availability have made it a firm favourite with owners, flight schools and syndicates for decades, ensuring straightforward ownership and strong long-term appeal.

Presented in great overall condition, G-OARC is now available to view at the AT Aviation showroom. If you're looking for a well-equipped, capable complex aircraft that is equally at home on training sorties, weekend adventures or European touring, this Arrow IV deserves your attention. Contact the AT Aviation sales team today to arrange your viewing and discover why the Piper Arrow should be your next aircraft!

Description:
AT Aviation is pleased to offer this well-presented Piper PA28-161 Warrior II, G-OZJX, now available at our showroom in Lee-on-Solent. The Warrior II is one of the most trusted and widely used aircraft for training and private operations. G-OZJX is a particularly fine example, combining thoughtful upgrades and an excellent overall condition.

‍

G-OZJX  is equipped with a strong Garmin avionics package, at the centre is a Garmin GTN 650 GPS/NAV/COM, supported by a Garmin Audio Panel, Nav/Com, and Transponder. Dual Garmin G5 electronic flight instruments provide modern, reliable primary flight data, while the inclusion of a BendixKing ADF and DME makes the aircraft especially suitable for comprehensive training.

‍

The interior was fully refurbished last year, with upgraded headlining, seats, and side panels all round. The result is a modern, comfortable cabin environment which is presented in excellent condition with a high-quality finish. This recent upgrade significantly enhances the overall appeal of the aircraft and reflects the care and investment made by the current owner.

‍

Externally, the aircraft was repainted approximately four to five years ago by Airtime and continues to present very well. The aircraft has always been hangared and maintained to a high standard, which is evident in its appearance and overall condition. It is clear that this Warrior II has been consistently well cared for.

‍

G-OZJX will be sold with a fresh annual inspection, ensuring it is ready for immediate operation for its next owner. With its combination of dependable performance, upgraded avionics, recent interior refurbishment, and excellent presentation, this Piper Warrior II represents an outstanding opportunity for both private owners and training organisations alike.

‍

For more details or to schedule a viewing please get in touch today!

‍

The cabin provides comfortable seating for two with removable dual controls on the passenger side.

Robinson R22 Versatility
The Robinson R22 is a classic example of design excellence. No other helicopter in its class can match its speed, reliability, affordable price, and low operating costs. The R22 has fewer accidents due to aircraft or engine failure than other light helicopters, and Robinson’s commitment to the highest quality in design, materials, and craftsmanship make it the enduring choice for flight training, radio traffic watch, power line patrol, and other applications that require performance, dependability, efficiency, and easy maintenance.

Description:
If you’ve been following prices of the Piper PA-32s over in the US, you’d know this type is finally commanding the prices to match its ability. The space available for both people and baggage makes it a GA business tool, and that is what N2989M has been. The owner has relied on this aircraft for meetings all over the UK, France and the continent that he simply had to attend. As a result, the panel has been comprehensively updated to allow IFR flight in a stress-free fashion, and the airframe has been cleaned up with speed mods that allow true airspeeds of over 145kts in flight. A keen eye will see the spats and various gap seals & fairings applied to make her faster than the rest of the field.

This is a late model 1978 airframe with 6173hrs TT and 1260hrs on the 300HP IO-540-K1G5 engine and Hartzell 3-blade prop installed March 2014. The aircraft has been hangared in the owner's heated hangar since importation in June 2005, and they have now traded up to a turbine aircraft.

The panel is exceptional with a Garmin GMA-340 Audio Panel, Garmin GTN-650 WAAS GPS/Nav/Com working with Aspen 1000 PFD, Garmin GNS-430 with Garmin GI-106A indicator. There is an Avidyne TCAS 600 Traffic system, which is a high-value item, along with the S-Tec System 30 Alt Autopilot. The DME is King KN64, and the Mode S transponder is Garmin GTX-330. The owner has also added the Precise Flight System III standby vacuum system. In July 2019, the aircraft was repainted in distinctive colours where the company branding was decaled on for easy removal. The interior has been updated with beige leather seats, new side trims and distinctive tartan inlays.

Die Tecnam P2006T NG (Next Generation) ist ein modernes, zweimotoriges Viersitzflugzeug, das speziell für Multi-Engine-Ausbildung, Charterbetrieb und effiziente Reiseflüge entwickelt wurde. Aufbauend auf dem bewährten P2006T-Konzept bietet die NG-Version über 300 konstruktive Verbesserungen in den Bereichen Ergonomie, Sicherheit, Effizienz und Avionik.

Angetrieben von zwei Rotax 912 iSc3 Motoren mit elektronischer Direkteinspritzung (FADEC) überzeugt die P2006T NG durch außergewöhnlich niedrigen Kraftstoffverbrauch und einfache Bedienung. Das gutmütige Flugverhalten, insbesondere bei Engine-Out-Manövern, macht die P2006T NG zu einer idealen Plattform für professionelle ATOs und Flugschulen. 
Die überarbeitete Kabine mit drei Türen, größerer Verglasung, verbesserter Geräuschdämmung und neu gestaltetem Zentralpedestal bietet hohen Komfort und optimale Zugänglichkeit – sowohl für Schulungs- als auch für Reiseeinsätze.

Die Tecnam P-Mentor ist ein hochmodernes, zweisitziges Schulflugzeug, das speziell für die Anforderungen moderner Flugschulen, ATOs und professioneller Ausbildungsbetriebe entwickelt wurde. Sie ist das einzige zweisitzige Flugzeug ihrer Klasse mit IFR-Zulassung nach CS-23 und deckt ein außergewöhnlich breites Ausbildungsspektrum auf einer einzigen Plattform ab.

Angetrieben vom Rotax 912 iSc3 Motor mit elektronischer Direkteinspritzung (FADEC) überzeugt die P-Mentor durch sehr niedrigen Kraftstoffverbrauch, hohe Zuverlässigkeit und einfache Bedienung. Mit einem Verbrauch von rund 14 Litern pro Stunde zählt sie zu den wirtschaftlichsten IFR-Trainern am Markt und bietet gleichzeitig eine große Reichweite.

Die moderne Avionik auf Basis des Garmin G3X Touch Systems, ergänzt durch IFR-fähige Garmin-Komponenten, ermöglicht Schulung für PPL, Night VFR, IFR, PBN, Variable Pitch sowie UPRT. Das Cockpit ist gezielt darauf ausgelegt, die Pilotarbeitsbelastung zu reduzieren und den Übergang auf komplexere Flugzeuge optimal vorzubereiten.

Die großzügige Kabine mit Schiebehaube, hervorragender Rundumsicht, sehr guter Geräuschdämmung und ergonomischer Sitzposition bietet hohen Komfort für Schüler und Fluglehrer. Ein integriertes Ballistic Recovery System (BRS) sowie die Erfüllung der neuesten CS-23-Anforderungen unterstreichen den hohen Sicherheitsstandard der P-Mentor.

Dank niedriger Betriebs- und Wartungskosten eignet sich die P-Mentor ideal für intensiven Schulungsbetrieb, ist aber ebenso attraktiv für private Eigentümer, die ein modernes, voll IFR-fähiges Reiseflugzeug für zwei Personen suchen.

The TF3 is the smallest remote controlled aircraft tug of TowFLEXX. Within a few seconds the aircraft is picked up and can then be effortlessly manoeuvred to the desired location by remote control. The nose wheel is mounted on a specially designed turntable, which allows the operator to turn the tug 360° around the nose gear without twisting it.

UNIQUE 360° TECHNOLOGY
The turntable of the TF3 prevents the nose wheel from turning when manoeuvring. At the same time, this allows unprecedented flexibility: the aircraft tug can rotate 360° around the nose wheel, enabling manoeuvres that are not possible with conventional towing equipment.

Furthermore, this tug can be used to pull or push aircraft into the corners of the hangar. In this way, the available space can be used much more efficiently and revenues can also be increased, as more aircraft can be accommodated in the same space.

IT ONLY TAKES ONE PERSON
The radio remote control of the TF3 has a high range so that the user can move freely around the aircraft. This means that no further persons are needed to manoeuvre the aircraft safely. A safety frequency is used.

TOWFLEXX TF5 – UP TO 60.000KG / 132.000LBS

With its towing capacity of up to 60,000kg / 132,000 pounds, the TowFLEXX TF5 is a true heavyweight and unique in its class. Perfect for Super-Midsize Jets, Military Jets and Helicopters with Single- and Twin-Tires. However, the adjustable nose wheel adapters allow small aircraft to be moved. This makes the TF5 an absolute all-rounder, which is why it is used by FBOs, MROs, corporate flight departments, private owners and military personnel all over the world.

No Towbar, no Damages

Our Aircraft Tugs belong to the Category “Towbarless Tugs”. And there’s a good reason for that, because safety comes first. With our unique 360° technology, the nose wheel is picked up on a turntable, allowing the tug to move freely around the nose wheel without twisting it.

The newNPS (Nosewheel Protection System) offers even more safety and comfort during the tow. 

eCube – the central control unit:

The TF5 was developed to avoid costly downtimes. In the process, a central control unit was designed in which all electronic components and computers come together. In other words, this “eCube” not only protects the components inside, but can also be exchanged and replaced with a new eCube in a matter of minutes in the event of a malfunction.

Remote Control of the TF5
The TowFLEXX TF5 is operated via a multifunction remote control. In the default configuration, it connects via radio, but if the supplied backup cable is connected between the remote control and the tug, any radio transmissions are disabled, which can be quite important for some locations.

Frequency Overlap & Interference
The radio remote controls used operate on a safety broadcast. Due to the LBT frequency search (Listen before Talk), interference with other devices is almost impossible. Before signals are translated into control commands, it is checked whether the frequency channel is being used. If this is the case, the radio remote control automatically switches to a free channel. This process is handled in miliseconds and is not noticeable to the user.



This technology allows the modernization of older units as well! This means that new revisions usually feature technical innovations that were not yet installed in previous models (for example, the line assistant or the NPS system). Simply summarized: by installing a new eCube, an existing unit can be revamped to incorporate new features and expand its capabilities.

In addition, the eCube also houses the Charger for the tug, the charger for a spare battery of the radio remote control, a data logger, which can be helpful for error analysis, a display over which hours of operation and possible error codes are displayed, the central key switch to put the unit into operation and further interfaces for programming etc.

Description:
We are very pleased to advise that this magnificent Spitfire Mk.XIVe is now available for acquisition. Embargoed until this moment, this is a unique opportunity to secure one of the finest examples of the marque in existence.
The Spitfire Mk.XIVe represents the ultimate evolution of the breed. By pairing the legendary Supermarine airframe with the immense power of the Rolls-Royce Griffon engine, this variant defined the final stages of the Second World War. It is a stunning combination of raw, high-altitude performance and that classic, elegant profile that still captures the imagination like no other fighter.

This particular specimen was the subject of a comprehensive, ground-up restoration by Historic Flying, Audley End, UK. Then after a take-off incident in New Zealand, it went to AvSpecs Ltd at Ardmore, New Zealand who carried out the necessary repairs to the aircraft including the application of its striking SEAC colour scheme. The aircraft has subsequently flown just 23 hours since its return to the air.

Over the last decade, this glorious restoration has served as the undisputed star attraction at the highly acclaimed Omaka Aviation Heritage Centre in Blenheim, New Zealand, where it has been admired by around 30,000 visitors per year. When it hasn’t been on display, it has been a crowd favourite at the spectacular Classic Fighters Omaka airshows, where it has consistently thrilled thousands of enthusiasts with its breathtaking handling and that unmistakeable Griffon roar.

It is a privilege to bring such a significant piece of aviation history to the market. This is a rare chance to own a true masterpiece of engineering that is not only a museum-quality showpiece but a proven, exhilarating performer.

Aircraft Location: Stratford Upon Avon, Warwickshire, United Kingdom
Description:
Robinson Helicopter Company offers their new 2-seat version of the Robinson R44, named the Robinson R44 Cadet. The best all round 2 seat helicopter with the power, space and speed of a 4-seat helicopter but significantly lower purchase price and operating cost. Book your demo today.

The ultimate 2-seat helicopter, offering the highest speeds, greatest stability, huge luggage capacity and a wide array of upgrades including HeliSAS / Autopilot, floats and more.

Stability, Speed, Space and Power
The cruise speed is one of the best in class for a 2 seat helicopter at 107 kt, whilst offering a 300nm maximum range with no reserve. This gives an amazing 489 lb (268kg) pilot, passenger and baggage capacity with full fuel. The newly designed muffler reduces the R44 Cadet’s flyover noise signature to more than 3 decibels lower than the current R44 Raven I.
The lower weight and derated power provide increased performance margins at high altitudes and extend the time between overhaul from 2200 hours to 2400 hours.

Robinson R44 Cadet Versatility
The Robinson R44 Cadet has 2 front seats with the original R44 rear seats having been removed, providing plenty of space for cargo in the rear of the helicopter. The R44 Cadet comes with a 300nm maximum range and a maximum operating altitude of 14000 ft. The R44 Cadet will be equipped with the same basic airframe, rotor system and Lycoming O-540-F1B5 engine as the R44 Raven I; the maximum gross weight is 2200lb, and the engine power derated to 210 HP takeoff / 185 HP continuous. This helicopter can efficiently be used for training or utility operations and will have a variety of optional equipment available including Air Conditioning, HeliSAS, Autopilot and avionics packages.

Aircraft Location: Stratford Upon Avon, Warwickshire, United Kingdom
Description:
The Robinson R44 – four seat helicopter is the most popular helicopter in the world today. Over 3000 R44 helicopters have been sold. The Robinson R44 Raven II is the latest derivative of the very successful and proven R44 helicopter line and now available with HeliSAS and Autopilot.

Exceed Expectations.
The ideal blend of proven and innovative engineering. Delivering cutting edge, industry leading and reliable helicopters both for your own travel as well as with customization options for a huge range of missions and applications.

Robinson R44 Operating Performance
The new fuel-injected engine provides higher power for better performance and eliminates the need for carburettor heat. The engine is de-rated to 245 HP for 5 minutes and 205 HP maximum continuous rating, to assure a longer life and lower cost of maintenance. Overall, the Raven II provides a favourable 100 lb increase in the Robinson R44’s gross weight and increased IGE and OGE hover ceilings. Another major enhancement is the reduced noise level of the Raven II. The quieter helicopter features redesigned main and tail rotor blades. Both sets of rotors are fitted with noise attenuating blade tip caps that decrease flyover noise by 1dB. The main rotor blades also have more surface area for increased lifting capability at altitude.

Robinson R44 Versatility
The Raven II is equipped with a fuel-injected, angle-valve, tuned-induction, IO-540 Lycoming engine which produces substantially more power and gives the R44 Raven II greater altitude performance, more payload, and increased speed. The Robinson R44 Raven II configuration is also available as an IFR Trainer, Newscopter, Police Helicopter, and Clipper II (with floats).

And why not add the HeliSAS and Autopilot too.

New Robinson R44 Pricing & Delivery
Buying a new Robinson R44 is made easy with Heli Air. Call our helicopter sales team today for further details about how to buy an R44, and for any friendly, professional advice about which helicopter may suit you best.

This level of avionics modernisation significantly enhances situational awareness, reliability, and the overall cockpit experience.
‍
We are pleased to welcome this aircraft back into our inventory, having sold it previously and knowing it to be a well-cared-for example with lovely paintwork and strong presentation.
